title: 论点—证据—图表映射模板

description.zh: 原创可编辑 SVG，将科学主张、控制实验/消融与论文图表对应起来，方便发现缺失证据。
description.en: Editable claim-to-evidence-to-figure map connecting a scientific claim to controlled tests, metrics, ablations, and paper artifacts.

zh: 论文已有核心论点，但实验还没有清晰组织
设计消融实验和结果图前需要逐项核对论据
en: A paper has a central claim but scattered experimental evidence
Mapping ablations and figures before writing the results section

zh: 为每条主张对应可证伪的实验与基线
记录指标、对照条件、消融及混杂因素
检查最终图表和 caption 是否真正支持正文
en: Connect each claim to falsifiable tests and baselines
Record metrics, controls, ablations and confounders
Verify the final figure and caption support the text

zh: 不得把模板里的括号占位内容当成真实实验设置
漂亮流程图不能替代控制实验和实际结果
en: All bracketed labels are placeholders, not real experiments
A neat chart cannot substitute for controlled experiments and results
